## Verdict

Heronry costs least for a team of 45, at $405 per month. Its $9 per-seat rate is the lowest on the list, and its 10-seat minimum sits well below the team size, so all 45 seats bill at list with nothing wasted.

## Vendors

| Vendor | Price per seat | Minimum seats |
|---|---|---|
| Juno Board | $15 | 40 |
| Cygnus Flow | $21 | 1 |
| Heronry | $9 | 10 |

## Cost at this size

Seats paid for is the team size (45) or the vendor minimum, whichever is larger. All three minimums fall below 45, so every vendor bills for exactly 45 seats.

- **Juno Board:** 45 × $15 = **$675 per month**
- **Cygnus Flow:** 45 × $21 = **$945 per month**
- **Heronry:** 45 × $9 = **$405 per month**

Heronry is $270 per month cheaper than Juno Board and $540 per month cheaper than Cygnus Flow — $3,240 and $6,480 over twelve months. The spread between cheapest and dearest is $540 per month.

## Risks

At 45 seats the minimums do nothing, so this ranking rests entirely on per-seat rate. That makes it stable upward: every vendor scales linearly and Heronry's lead widens in absolute terms as the team grows. It is less stable downward. Below 40 people Juno Board's floor starts billing unused seats, and below 10 Heronry's does the same, at which point Cygnus Flow's 1-seat minimum becomes relevant.

This is a price comparison and nothing more. The list gives per-seat rates and seat minimums only — no features, support tiers, usage caps, security posture or integrations — so the cheapest vendor may not clear the team's functional bar.

All figures assume list price billed monthly, as stated. Annual commitments, volume discounts at 45 seats, onboarding fees and migration costs are not in the source and could reorder these totals.
